title: NSH: add dissector-table for NSH TLV data dissection
description:
The dissecting of vendor-specific TLVs in the NSH is added.

Two commits are included:
- First commit cleans up the tlv dissection and introduces sub-trees per TLV
- Second commit introduces a dissector-table that can also be extended from lua scripts

The second commit also contains a set of dissectors for TLVs defind by BBF in TR-459i2.
